messages:
ana_sales: Hey team — Orion Labs POC tripped over 403s on /v1/embeddings and some 429s during a parallel load. Can we swarm?

ana_sales: They pasted this failing curl (key redacted):
```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer orion_poc_abcd' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: orion' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-Project: onboarding' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}'```

ana_sales: Responses include `{"error":"permission_denied","message":"org binding mismatch"}`, `{"error":"invalid_scope","message":"missing scope: embeddings"}` and occasional `{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":3}` during their ramp.

vivek_se: Two separate issues likely: org/project header mismatch and key scope. Ask them to confirm which project they created the key under and whether they chose "embeddings" when creating the key.

brooke_sre: I'll pull auth events for that key prefix. @audit-bot can you query 2245678301..2245678901 for prefix "orion_poc_ab" and return redacted binds?

audit-bot: Queried auth index for prefix "orion_poc_ab" between 2245678301 and 2245678901. Found 16 events: 9 permission_denied (org-bind), 4 invalid_scope, 3 rate_limited. Returning redacted bind info and samples.

brooke_sre: Snippet: `AUTH FAIL key=orion_poc_ab... reason=org_mismatch bound_org=orion-inc bound_project=orion-test header_org=orion header_project=onboarding request=/v1/embeddings`

brooke_sre: Control-plane shows key=orion_poc_abcd bound_org=orion-inc bound_project=orion-test key_type=service scopes=[generate]

vivek_se: Ah — the customer used the short slug `orion` and created a project `onboarding`, but the key is bound to `orion-inc` and `orion-test`. Headers must match binding exactly. Also the key lacks `embeddings` scope so embedding calls 403 with invalid_scope.

vivek_se: Fast remediation: 1) change headers to `X-Redwood-Org: orion-inc` and `X-Redwood-Project: orion-test`, OR create a new key bound to onboarding. 2) If they need embeddings, create a service key with scopes [generate,embeddings] bound to the correct project.

ana_sales: I told Orion to switch headers to orion-inc/orion-test and to generate a new service key called `orion-onb-emb`. They updated headers and retried — normal calls returned 200 immediately, but during the stress run still saw a few 429s at peak.

brooke_sre: 429s look like per-key TPS throttling in the sandbox. We can temporarily bump their key/project burst for the demo. How long is the demo window?

ana_sales: Demo runs for 50 minutes starting now. They want two 1-minute high-concurrency ramps.

brooke_sre: Approve a temporary bump: project_quota.bump project=orion-test delta=+45 duration=1h. Applying now and will revert at 2245682501.

audit-bot: Patch applied: project_quota.bump project=orion-test delta=+45 duration=3600s. Monitoring auth events.

nana_sales: Orion reran the ramps; no more 429s. Embedding calls return 200. They also asked about pricing for sustained throughput. I looped in AE.

li_security: Two quick items: 1) please avoid pasting full keys in public channels (we redacted; thanks). 2) for security questionnaires, add a short blurb explaining org vs project binding and key scopes and that keys can be limited per-scope and per-project. Customers miss that and it causes delays.

vivek_se: Agreed — I'll add a one-paragraph note to the presales checklist and open DOCS-7789 to clarify the error messages for `org_mismatch` and `invalid_scope` to include actionable remediation (e.g., expected org/project names when safe).

an a_sales: Orion is green for the demo and AE is following up on throughput pricing. Closing swarm. :tada:
